Slope Rider
About Slope Rider

Get ready to hit the slopes in a brand-new sledding adventure across winter courses full of deadly obstacles and hazards! It's time to dive into breathtaking scenery and ... try to survive as long as possible. Play Slope Rider, steer your sled skillfully through dynamic snowy slopes, and aim to score the highest points possible.

Slope Rider: Enjoy the Fast-Paced & Unpredictable Terrain

Slope Rider is a thrilling, endless sledding game set in a breathtaking winter wonderland, where you ride a sled racing through snowy forests and icy terrain. The goal is straightforward: survive on ever-changing snowy slopes & earn the best score possible by evading obstacles and collisions. The longer you last, the higher your score. 

However, that’s never an easy task. Obstacles, like pine trees, dropping ice, ice-capped boulders, rolling snowballs, and more, are constantly in your path. And just a moment of lost focus or a slight delay in steering can send your sled crashing into an obstacle, instantly ending your run.
